desc:
💰 Watch the sticks sort themselves and get rich doing it! Every stick that lands in place pays you, and the faster your algorithm, the more money you make.

🔒 PRIVATE SERVERS = x2 MONEY + x2 LUCK! Free with Roblox Plus.
🕒 Time Boost resets if offline more than 2 minutes 

🔥 Unlock 23 real sorting algorithms, from Bubble Sort to legendary ones
🍀 Catch Lucky Blocks that drop during the sort for rare algorithms
💸 Buy upgrades for more sticks, more speed and more cash per stick
♻️ Rebirth for permanent money and luck boosts (up to 1000 rebirths!)
🌈 Rainbow sorts pay double

🧠 Build your Permanent Upgrade tree: Auto Shuffle, Lucky Blocks, Double Blocks, Offline Earnings, Time Boost, Friend Boost and more. Every rebirth gives you a free Lucky Block!

😴 Earn money even while you're offline, collect your Daily Rewards and play with friends for an extra boost.

🎧 Relax with satisfying ASMR sorting sounds: Keyboard, Piano, Violin, Synth and more.

JOIN SERVER FOR CODES
